title: Floor/Ceil in Sorted Array
problemStatement: Find the floor (largest value <= x) and ceil (smallest value >= x) in a sorted array.
intuition: Ceil is lower_bound. Floor is the element just before it. One binary search answers both.

approaches.title: Optimal: one binary search tracking both
approaches.idea: Update floor on the left branch, ceil on the right.
approaches.whyWorks: Every discarded half is provably on the wrong side of x.

edgeCases: x below the minimum -> floor None
x above the maximum -> ceil None
commonMistakes: Returning indices where values were asked (or vice versa)
Updating the wrong tracker on each branch
patternRecognition: Floor/ceil are the lower/upper bound pair in disguise
interviewInsight: Tie it back to lower/upper bound explicitly; interviewers like the unification.

related.title: Find the first or last occurrence of a given number in a sorted array
